description: This file defines a singleton object 'WorkSchedulers' responsible for scheduling background media analysis tasks using Android's WorkManager, with constraints on network connectivity and battery usage. The function 'scheduleMediaAnalysis' enqueues a periodic worker to run every 24 hours, respecting specified constraints.

classes.name: WorkSchedulers
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to schedule background work with specific constraints, currently including a periodic media analysis task.

methods.name: scheduleMediaAnalysis
methods.description: Schedules a periodic media analysis worker that runs every 24 hours with network and battery constraints.
